CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

5. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.

   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
